name: flowlines
description: Flowlines agent observability: analyse your Flowlines workspace over MCP, instrument MCP servers, and export Claude Code and Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Agent observability for MCP servers and coding agents
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Flowlines workspace over MCP so you can ask what your agents' users did, what changed since a release, and where sessions go wrong. Bundles two skills: one instruments an MCP server with the Flowlines telemetry contract, the other installs full-content telemetry for Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions.
defaultPrompt: What changed in my Flowlines namespace this week?
Use $flowlines-mcp-observability to instrument this MCP server.
Use $flowlines-agent-observability to export my Codex sessions.
